comment: D6/D4 platform differences (总纲 §3.8). A difference is allowed only if it is a platform fact, and every entry states the fact and why matching the other end would be a lie. Anything not on this list is drift; the parity gate counts it as such. Copy-value platform facts stay in contracts/copy-exceptions.json (frozen by their own gate).

differences.ios: edge-swipe / back chevron in modal sheets
differences.android: system back key and gesture, BackHandler closes the overlay first
differences.reason: iOS sheets are dismissed by the system gesture or a visible control; Android owns the back key. Both close the topmost layer first (DuckRoute reducer).

differences.android: ModalBottomSheet with skipPartiallyExpanded where the content is one screen
differences.reason: Each platform's sheet is the native one users know; the content and the route are identical.

differences.ios: inline card / pill, no system toast
differences.android: Toast for command rejections that have no card surface
differences.reason: Android has a system transient channel; iOS does not. Where a surface exists, both use inline state instead.
The map (pet/skill/feed/fall/route-done) is identical; only the API differs.
Same semantics, per-platform storage; both persist the choice across process death since D1.
